summary: Frontend-only EN localisation test on preview (430x900, admin@mikilab.de PRO). Language switcher IT/DE/EN works with zero console/page errors and no white screens. Verified EN in: News, Photo-Diagnosis page (incl. its Bread Encyclopedia which DOES show 'German flours for Italian bakers'), Shop products + Academy courses (Classic/Chocolate & Walnut/Pistachio Panettone, Big Leavened Cakes Masterclass, Bread Basics Course, EN descriptions + 'Allergens: Gluten, Eggs, Milk'), Checklists (all 4 EN templates + EN items), Shopping List (EN header/labels, empty state), Maestro chat suggestions, Home concept blocks, plus IT and DE regression. Found 4 residual Italian/German leaks in EN mode (Learn>Encyclopedia tab, Beginners cards+quiz, PaywallGate, Academy header/duration) and one dead-code file holding the EN sourdough guide.

ui_bugs.issue: ENTRIES has only it/de keys -> `ENTRIES[lang] || ENTRIES.it` falls back to ITALIAN when lang=en. Learn > Encyclopedia tab in EN shows 'Miglioratore Naturale Pro', 'Per tutti gli impasti...', 'Kochstueck (con Haferflocken)', 'Autolisi', 'Idratazione'. The requested EN entries exist in data/content.js but are only rendered by sections/Encyclopedia.jsx (Diagnosis page), not by this tab.

BEGINNERS (6 cards) and QUIZ objects have only it/de -> in EN the beginner cards show Italian ('I quattro ingredienti', 'Per fare il pane bastano farina, acqua...') and the Baker Quiz is Italian, although the page header/planner are correctly EN.

Language handling is binary (`const it = lang !== 'de'`), so EN users see ITALIAN paywall copy ('La Sezione Principianti e inclusa nell'accesso PRO...', 'Guarda cosa fa', 'Accedi per continuare', 'Basi passo-passo', 'Quiz del Fornaio'). Additionally the sectionName passed in is wrong for EN: LearnHub.jsx uses `t('nav_impara')==='Impara' ? IT : DE` -> EN shows GERMAN 'Sektion Anfaenger'; App.js passes hardcoded Italian sectionNames ('Il Tuo Laboratorio', 'Diagnosi', 'Sezione Principianti').
ui_bugs.selector: n/a (logged-out / non-PRO Learn, Your Lab, Diagnosis, Enterprise)

ui_bugs.issue: Heading 'Academy & Servizi' is hardcoded Italian in all languages; course duration strings come from backend as Italian only ('8 lezioni - 2h', '12 lezioni - 3h', '6 lezioni - 1.5h') with no duration_en/duration_de -> Italian shown in EN and DE. Course titles/descriptions themselves are correctly EN.

Dead code: Mikilab.jsx (the only consumer of content[lang].lievitoMadre, i.e. the Sourdough Starter guide with 'What sourdough starter is') is not imported/rendered anywhere in the app (App.js has no 'mikilab' tab). The new EN lievitoMadre translations are therefore unreachable in the UI and could not be verified.

issues: Recipe/day pickers use native browser <select> elements instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere (pre-existing, cosmetic)

action_items: Add an `en` block to ENTRIES in sections/Enciclopedia.jsx (or make LearnHub reuse sections/Encyclopedia.jsx which already reads content[lang].encyclopedia).
Add `en` blocks to BEGINNERS and QUIZ in sections/Beginners.jsx.
Make PaywallGate.jsx tri-lingual (it/de/en) and fix sectionName passing in LearnHub.jsx (currently returns German for EN) and App.js (hardcoded Italian).
Translate Academy heading ('Academy & Services') and add duration_en/duration_de to the backend COURSES seed.
Decide on sections/Mikilab.jsx: either wire it into a route/tab (so the EN sourdough guide is reachable) or delete the dead file.
critical_code_review_comments: Localisation is duplicated across per-component dictionaries (Enciclopedia ENTRIES, Beginners BEGINNERS/QUIZ, Home CONCEPTS, Checklists TEMPLATES) with inconsistent fallbacks; several use `X[lang] || X.it` which silently regresses to Italian when a locale is missing. Consider centralising in data/content.js and adding a dev-time assertion that every dictionary has it/de/en keys.
Binary language checks (`lang !== 'de'`, `const de = lang === 'de'`) remain in PaywallGate.jsx and Shop.jsx-style components; grep for them and replace with the tri() helper.
Backend seed data mixes translated fields (name_en/desc_en present) with untranslated ones (duration) - add *_en/*_de for every user-visible string.

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (7/9 EN areas fully English; Encyclopedia tab + Beginners cards/quiz still Italian)

test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (login via header [data-testid=login-btn]; login is optional at boot)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav: header [data-testid=lang-it|lang-de|lang-en]; Shop/Academy reachable only via URL ?academy=1 (no bottom-nav tab); Checklists via nav-tab-maestro -> maestro-step-5 -> maestro-tool-check; Shopping list via maestro-tool-spesa (shows empty state unless a weekly plan is saved, so Water/Salt/Flours labels were NOT verified with data). DB recipe names stay Italian in EN by design (not a bug). 401s on /api/subscription/status before login are expected.
rca_of_the_issue: The new EN translations were added to data/content.js, but three UI areas keep their own local dictionaries with only it/de keys (Enciclopedia.jsx ENTRIES, Beginners.jsx BEGINNERS & QUIZ) and PaywallGate.jsx uses a binary it/de flag, so lang='en' falls through to Italian (or German for the sectionName ternary in LearnHub.jsx).
